title: Soft-luxury visual refinement for MeghRaj Exports (tokens, glass cards, typography, nav/hero/modal/footer)

requirements.summary: Update global theme tokens and base styles to the provided soft-luxury palette with warm/blue-tint surfaces and readable text contrast.
acceptanceCriteria: Global CSS variables in frontend/src/index.css reflect the specified palette (either directly as hex or as equivalent OKLCH values) and the default page background is warm/off-white rather than pure white or deep navy.
Foreground/body text uses #1F2A3A-equivalent (theme foreground) and muted text uses #5C677D-equivalent (theme muted-foreground), with readable contrast across all pages.
At least two section background treatments exist (warm off-white and very soft bluish tint) and are used across pages without altering layout/structure.

file_operations.description: Update :root theme tokens to match the soft-luxury palette (Primary Navy #0E1A2B, Warm Background #F4F1EA, Light Bluish Section Tint #EEF2F7, Accent Gold #C5A24D, Primary Text #1F2A3A, Muted Text #5C677D). Ensure body defaults use the warm background (not pure white), and update card/popover/border/input tokens to avoid white-on-white.

Apply both section background treatments across the Home page by switching existing section surface classes (e.g., some sections to warm background and others to the bluish tint) without changing structure.
Ensure the Products page uses the updated warm/blue-tint section surfaces (not flat white), via class adjustments only (no layout changes).
Adjust About page section/callout surface classes to align with the warm/blue-tint theme while keeping all existing content and structure intact.
Adjust Catalogue page surface classes to use the new warm/blue-tint section treatments and avoid pure-white blocks, without changing layout.

requirements.summary: Create a reusable glass card style and apply it consistently to all card-like UI and the modal content container.
acceptanceCriteria: A reusable glass card class/utility exists (e.g., in frontend/src/index.css Tailwind layer) matching the specified background/blur/border/radius/shadow constraints.

Cards in ProductsPage (category cards), CategoryHierarchy (subcategory cards), HomePage highlights cards, About/Catalogue info callouts, and SubcategoryCard all render with the glass card styling without changing their structure or content.
Hover states remain subtle (no heavy shadow jumps); any hover border emphasis uses gold at low opacity.

file_operations.description: Add a reusable glass card utility/class (e.g., .glass-card and a subtle hover variant) that matches: background rgba(255,255,255,0.65), backdrop blur 12px, border-radius 12px, 1px border rgba(197,162,77,0.25), and a soft subtle shadow (no glow/heavy shadows/strong gradients).
Apply the new glass card class/utility to product category cards (retain existing structure/content and interactions).
Apply the new glass card class/utility to subcategory cards (retain existing structure/content and interactions).
Apply the new glass card class/utility to the subcategory/product cards (retain existing structure/content and interactions).
Apply the new glass card class/utility to the Home page highlight/feature cards while preserving layout and copy.
Apply the new glass card class/utility to About page info callouts currently styled as cards (preserve structure/content).
Apply the new glass card class/utility to Catalogue page callouts/cards (preserve structure/content).
Apply the new glass card class/utility to Contact page side info cards and any other card-like containers (preserve structure/content).
Apply the glass card styling to the modal content container/panel, matching the specified glass constraints while keeping modal structure/behavior unchanged.

requirements.summary: Improve site-wide typography, spacing, and contrast for readability while preserving the existing layout structure.
acceptanceCriteria: No section with light background uses white text for headings/body copy; text colors follow the new foreground/muted palette.
Body copy line-height is consistently comfortable (no cramped paragraphs) across Home/About/Catalogue/Products/Subcategory/Contact pages.
Section padding increases are implemented via styling only (class changes), with no route/component restructuring.

file_operations.description: Refine base typography for readability (comfortable body line-height and elegant headings) and ensure default text colors are readable on warm/blue-tint surfaces; keep changes styling-only.
Increase section padding/breathing room via class changes only, and ensure text colors are not white-on-light in any non-hero areas.
Adjust padding and text color classes for improved readability (no layout restructuring).
Adjust padding and text color classes for improved readability (no layout restructuring).
Adjust padding and text color classes for improved readability (no layout restructuring).
Ensure any banner/overlay text remains readable and non-banner sections use foreground/muted palette (no white text on light backgrounds) and apply spacing-only refinements.
Ensure any banner/overlay text remains readable and non-banner sections use foreground/muted palette (no white text on light backgrounds) and apply spacing-only refinements.
Ensure form labels/inputs/messages maintain strong contrast using the updated palette; adjust spacing for readability without changing structure.

requirements.summary: Limit Accent Gold usage to premium highlights only (primary buttons, thin dividers, subtle hover borders, and active nav underline).
acceptanceCriteria: Buttons that are primary actions use gold as the background, with readable text color.
Dividers remain thin and subtle; gold is not used as large fills or broad backgrounds.
Card hover effects use a subtle gold border emphasis rather than strong glow/gradient.
Navigation active state uses a thin gold underline (not a filled pill/tab).

file_operations.description: Refine global button/divider utilities so gold is reserved for premium accents (primary button background, thin dividers, subtle hover borders, active nav underline). Update hover shadows to remain subtle (avoid heavy jumps).
Replace decorative gold usage (e.g., icon colors/fills or large gold-tinted areas) with foreground/muted styling, keeping gold only where specified (buttons/dividers/subtle card hover).
Remove decorative gold bullets/markers and ensure any gold usage is limited to subtle hover border emphasis only; keep structure unchanged.
Replace decorative gold bullet dots/accents used in lists/callouts with muted/foreground alternatives; keep gold limited to allowed use cases.
Replace decorative gold bullet dots/accents used in lists/callouts with muted/foreground alternatives; keep gold limited to allowed use cases.

Replace decorative gold bullets/markers inside the modal (e.g., feature list dots) with muted/foreground alternatives; keep gold only for the primary action button and thin borders/dividers where applicable.
Ensure the only gold usage in navigation is the thin active underline (no filled gold backgrounds/pills).

requirements.summary: Refine header/navigation to a translucent light surface with blur and dark navy text, using a thin gold underline for active links (desktop + mobile).
acceptanceCriteria: Header uses a translucent light surface with backdrop blur on all routes (including the home page) and uses dark text by default.
Active desktop nav item shows a thin gold underline; inactive items use muted text and become foreground on hover.
Mobile nav avoids heavy filled active backgrounds; active state is indicated primarily via thin gold accent/underline/border.
No changes to nav items, routes, or header layout structure.

file_operations.description: Update header surface styling so it is consistently translucent light with blur (including on home), switch default nav text to dark navy/foreground, and keep active state as a thin gold underline. Remove heavy fills for both desktop and mobile active states while preserving current nav structure/behavior.

requirements.summary: Polish the Home hero styling with a localized text-area overlay gradient and improved readability (no overly dark full-hero wash).
acceptanceCriteria: Hero overlay is localized to the text region (e.g., a positioned gradient panel), not a full-width full-opacity dark wash over the entire hero image.
Hero heading and subheading maintain high contrast and readability without relying on pure white-on-white combinations.
Hero buttons follow the gold/secondary styling rules and remain legible over the image.

file_operations.description: Adjust hero overlay implementation so the gradient is localized behind the text region only (not an across-hero wash). Update hero text and button surface styles to remain readable and aligned to the palette and gold accent rules.
If needed, add a small reusable utility for the hero text backdrop/overlay panel styling to keep the effect consistent and subtle (no strong gradients).

requirements.summary: Update modal styling to match the soft luxury theme while preserving existing modal structure and interactions.
acceptanceCriteria: ProductQuickViewModal panel uses the glass card style (or a modal-specific glass variant) with a thin gold border and soft shadow; no heavy glow/gradients.
Modal backdrop remains subtle and does not darken the screen excessively; blur remains present.
Close button styling remains accessible and consistent with the new palette.

file_operations.description: Refine modal panel to use the glass card treatment (off-white surface with slight blur, thin gold border, elegant spacing) and adjust backdrop to be subtle (retain ESC/click outside/scroll lock behaviors).
Ensure modal-related utilities/animations support the new soft-luxury look (subtle shadowing and surfaces), avoiding heavy shadows/glow/strong gradients.

requirements.summary: Update footer styling to align with the soft luxury theme and readability rules while keeping content unchanged.
acceptanceCriteria: Footer background and text colors are consistent with the global theme and maintain strong contrast.
Footer headings are not forced to white on a light background; link hover states remain subtle and premium.
Existing footer content/structure (company info, quick links, contact, caffeine.ai referral) remains unchanged.

file_operations.description: Update footer surface and typography classes to use foreground/muted colors (no white headings on light surfaces) and keep gold accents minimal (links/dividers only), without changing footer content/structure.
Adjust any shared footer-related utilities (e.g., divider/link hover styling) so they match the soft luxury palette and the restricted gold usage rules.
